overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Weston Plan Commission was scheduled to meet on September 14, 2026, to consider several land development matters including a preliminary condominium plat review, an amended final plat for a subdivision, and compliance issues with three approved conditional use permits. The meeting was also set to review staff-approved surveys, building permits, and receive a departmental project update.

discussions.item: Project #20260315 – Preliminary Condominium Plat Review for 4603, 4605, 4607, 4609, 4611 and 4613 Camp Phillips Road
discussions.body: The Plan Commission was scheduled to review a preliminary condominium plat for six properties on Camp Phillips Road. The commission was expected to consider the plat's compliance with Village zoning requirements and development standards.

discussions.item: Project #20250424 – Amended Final Plat of Bull Junior View Subdivision (Reedy Builders/Vreeland)
discussions.body: The Commission was set to review an amended final plat for the Bull Junior View Subdivision. The agenda indicated the commission was expected to consider modifications to the previously approved subdivision plat.

discussions.item: Compliance with Approved Conditional Use Permits
discussions.body: The Plan Commission was scheduled to discuss identified violations of three approved Conditional Use Permits and consider how to proceed through possible modification, revocation, or other appropriate action for USSAM at 3107 Concord Avenue (CUP No. 20240072), BUG Properties at 6406 Schofield Avenue (CUP No. 1890229), and Tommy's Car Wash at 1611 Schofield Avenue (CUP No. 20191300). The discussion was set to address compliance issues in accordance with Section 94.16.06(11) of the Village of Weston Zoning Code.

discussions.item: August 2026 Staff-Approved Certified Survey Maps and Site Plans
discussions.body: The Commission was scheduled to review certified survey maps and site plans that had been approved by staff during August 2026. This agenda item was set to provide an informational update on staff-level approvals.
The Commission was expected to receive information on building permits issued during August 2026. This agenda item was set to inform commissioners of development activity in the Village.

discussions.item: Planning & Development Department Monthly Project Update Report
discussions.body: The Commission was scheduled to receive a monthly project update report from the Planning & Development Department. The report was set to inform commissioners of ongoing departmental activities and project status.

publicComment: Public comment was indicated on the agenda through two mechanisms: an open public comment period for items not appearing as public hearings, and remote participation instructions via Zoom with a 'Raise Hand' feature for public speakers.
